context: A police officer discusses a case
purpose: Teach: 嘆く/本性/有様/人道的/勇敢/執念/スクープ/高学年

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、市民が、絶対、現状を、絶対、嘆く、絶対、声、絶対、警察、絶対、届いております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The voices of citizens expressing concern about this case have reached us, and we're genuinely grateful for that.
lines.style: Steady, professional opening. Clear diction. Measured pace, no rush. Slight emphasis on 'grateful'—official but sincere.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者、本気で、絶対、本性、絶対、捜査で、絶対、明らかに、なってきたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The suspect's true nature has become clearer through the investigation, hasn't it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, observant tone. Slight upward lift at the end—genuine curiosity, not interrogative. Slow, deliberate pacing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。事件現場の、本気で、絶対、有様、絶対、警察、絶対、慎重に、絶対、記録、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've been recording the scene carefully and methodically, the way it should be handled.
lines.style: Measured, procedural. Matter-of-fact delivery. Slight weight on 'carefully'—conveying professional integrity without self-congratulation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 被害者支援、本気で、絶対、人道的、絶対、観点から、絶対、進められているそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: And victim support has been moving forward from a genuinely humanitarian perspective, from what I understand.
lines.style: Reflective, appreciative. Soft opening. Slightly slower pace. Trailing upward at the end—genuine question seeking confirmation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。市民の中に、本気で、絶対、勇敢な、絶対、目撃者、絶対、いらっしゃいました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Among the citizens, there was a brave witness who came forward.
lines.style: Direct, slightly proud. Quiet emphasis on 'brave.' Composed delivery. Finishing with a note of quiet respect.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、執念を持って、絶対、捜査、絶対、続けて、絶対、こられたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police have continued the investigation with real determination, haven't they.
lines.style: Admiring undertone. Slow, deliberate pacing. Slight breathiness on 'determination'—acknowledging effort without overstating it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。本件、本気で、絶対、各紙の、絶対、スクープ、絶対、警察、絶対、対応、絶対、必要となります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. This case requires careful coordination with the media outlets that have reported on it.
lines.style: Procedural, factual. Even pacing. Clinical delivery—acknowledging necessity without drama. Professional weight on 'coordination.'

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地域の高学年児童、本気で、絶対、防犯教室、絶対、警察、絶対、お願いしたいですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I think we should ask the police to conduct a crime prevention class for the older children in the district.
lines.style: Earnest, forward-looking. Slightly lighter tone—a genuine suggestion, not a demand. Gentle upward lilt at the end.
